proposedIdentity.organizationRelationship: Legally independent cantonal Pro Senectute organization within the federated Pro Senectute system; Pro Senectute Suisse is the national umbrella.

evidence.title: Pro Senectute — accompagnement et aide à domicile

conclusions.statement: The current Vaud public-facing and registered name is Pro Senectute Vaud.
Pro Senectute Vaud is identified under UID CHE-106.079.897 and is legally independent from Pro Senectute Suisse.
conclusions.ambiguity: The reviewed official pages use both association language and the registered name without requiring Lia to choose a legal-form label now.

conclusions.statement: The Lia record points to the cantonal elderly-support organization, not a specific home-care office, Spitex unit, or nursing provider.

Pro Senectute Vaud currently presents home visits and practical/social accompaniment, while official Pro Senectute material distinguishes accompaniment from medical and nursing care provided primarily by health professionals and home-care services.
conclusions.ambiguity: National service descriptions instruct users to consult cantonal organizations; they do not prove that every listed service is directly operated in Vaud.

conclusions.statement: The current cantonal contact is Rue du Maupas 51, 1004 Lausanne, which does not match the legacy Lausanne 1012 location string.

unresolved: Whether any Pro Senectute Vaud accompaniment program belongs in Lia's provider catalog requires a later offering-level inclusion decision.
Which home-support services are directly operated by Pro Senectute Vaud, rather than described nationally or delivered through partners, must be evidenced service by service.
The origin of the legacy Lausanne 1012 location is not established by current official sources.

recommendation.oneRecordDisposition: Represent Pro Senectute Vaud as a cantonal organization first. Hold the legacy domicile-provider row until a later review proves a concrete, in-scope Vaud operating offering; do not split it merely because services are delivered regionally.
reasoning: The official identity is broader than home care and includes advice, social support, activities, housing, and accompaniment.
An older-adult mission or a home visit does not by itself establish a medical home-care provider identity.
